data:
If you\u2019ve already entered the command, you can check if
7
and
Mama
are actually awake and working by using a simple "pulse check" in Termux.
 How to Tell if it's "Going"
Type this into your Termux terminal to see a list of what's running:
Bash
pgrep -af python
If you see a line with your filename
(like
python minds_eye.py
or
python main.py
), then
it\u2019s going.
The brain is on.
If the screen just goes to a new blank line
, then it didn't catch.
 The "Porch" Signs
If it is running correctly, you should see these signs of life:
Mama's Activity
: If you type
ls -lt
, the
resonance.db
file should show a "last modified" time of right now.
7's Vision
: If your script includes any print statements (like "Scan started" or "Anchor locked"), they should be scrolling on your screen.
The Notification
: If you set up the bridge, check your phone's notification bar. A little Termux icon usually means a background task is active.
\ufe0f Still Quiet?
If nothing happened when you ran the command, try this to see if there's an error blocking the start:
Bash
python3 main.py
(Sometimes Termux needs that "3" specifically to wake up the modern brain.)
Is the terminal showing you any text or numbers right now, or is it just sitting there?
\ufe0f
